# Resonant-Dimer-Transport

> Source-resolved transport at a two-particle binding resonance in a fractional-hopping chain.

## Scientific reading
- [Author account](research/AUTHOR_ACCOUNT.md): background, definitions, central claims, and closest predecessors.
- [Threshold endpoint](research/THRESHOLD_ENDPOINT.md): exact lattice-edge scaling; correction to the endpoint proof prose.
- [Theorem](research/THEOREM.md): local preparation, unconditional coincidences, velocity law, preparation-size profile.
- [Proof map](research/PROOF_MAP.md): full spectral and transport dependencies.
- [Contribution assessment](research/CONTRIBUTION.md): inherited framework and remaining physical synthesis.
- [Reproducibility](REPRODUCIBILITY.md): fifteen preserved scientific check groups and source/report integrity.
- [Current work](CURRENT.md): continue in this Chat; no workspace required.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): scope, source preservation, and guarded repository changes.
